title: High-resolution mass spectrometry
caption: CO, N₂ and C₂H₄ all have a nominal mass of 28, but their exact masses differ because isotopic masses are not whole numbers (¹²C is exactly 12, ¹H is 1.0078, ¹⁴N 14.0031, ¹⁶O 15.9949). Measured to four decimal places they are easily told apart.
alt: Three narrow peaks near m/z 28: CO at 27.9949, N₂ at 28.0061 and C₂H₄ at 28.0313.
